papers.title_en: RobotAgentBench: Towards Open-world Robot Autonomy
papers.authors: Lingjun Mao, Jinglin Cao, Lukun He, Wenpeng Xu, Yuchen Yan, Hengyu Jin, Zijun Zhang, Jinzhou Tang, Songyao Jin, Ziche Liu, Yifei Shao, Junbo Huang, Fang Nan, Ruobing Han, Ziqiao Xi, Ziming Xu, Shuang Liang, Sibo Zhu, Wenyi Wu, Xinyue Wang, Yiming Huang, Xinkai Zou, Gao Zhu, Kun Zhou, Biwei Huang
papers.evidence: 评测开放世界家庭环境中的机器人自主智能体
papers.tldr: 视觉语言动作模型与世界动作模型提升了机器人操作能力，但开放世界自主还要求机器人发现任务、理解情境、执行操作并在失败后恢复，现有基准多只评估孤立能力。本文提出机器人智能体基准，借助智能体辅助和人类参与的真实到仿真流程，构建50种家庭布局，涵盖原子任务、长短程任务及开放场景，并从任务发现、情境推理、操作、失败恢复和鲁棒性等维度评测。实验揭示操作能力与自主能力之间存在明显差距，同时显示智能体架构和递归自我改进具有优势。该基准为统一比较模型与智能体、推动开放世界机器人自主研究提供系统工具。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAMs) have significantly improved robotic manipulation, yet deploying robots in the open world demands a higher level of autonomy beyond executing predefined tasks. Robot agents offer a promising paradigm for this transition, integrating task discovery, contextual reasoning, physical execution, and adaptive recovery into a closed interaction loop. However, existing benchmarks largely evaluate isolated capabilities, failing to capture the complexity of open-world robot autonomy. We introduce RobotAgentBench (RAB), a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating robot agents in realistic, open-world household environments. Through an agent-assisted, human-in-the-loop real-to-sim pipeline, RAB constructs 50 diverse household layouts with interactive objects and physically grounded tasks, encompassing 90 atomic tasks, 18 short-horizon tasks, 8 long-horizon tasks, and 4 open-ended scenarios. RAB provides a multi-level evaluation of robot agent capabilities: (1) task-level assessments systematically examine five complementary dimensions: task discovery, context reasoning, manipulation, failure recovery, and robustness; (2) scenario-level evaluation assesses how agents integrate these capabilities to autonomously fulfill high-level user needs. Furthermore, RAB enables systematic comparisons of standalone VLA/WAM models and diverse robot agent architectures under a unified planning-execution-verification framework. Extensive experiments reveal substantial gaps between manipulation and autonomy, demonstrate the advantages of agentic architectures and recursive self-improvement, and highlight the remaining challenges toward open-world robot autonomy.

papers.title_en: GOFish: Full Field-of-View Gaussian Splatting and Mesh Extraction
papers.authors: Allen Tu, Meher Gitika Karumuri, Shifan Zhu, Hailing Wang, Yen-Liang Lin, David Held, Matthias Zwicker, Tom Goldstein
papers.evidence: 鱼眼图像三维表面重建并提取对齐网格
papers.tldr: 鱼眼镜头可提供超广视场，但现有方法通常无法渲染超过180°的图像，也难以从同一场景提取对齐网格，限制了数字孪生的仿真应用。GOFish直接以鱼眼图像训练三维高斯表面模型，通过校准致密化恢复全视场表面，并用校准滤波和广角外观建模避免将模糊与镜头渐晕写入场景。它在200° FIORD和205° FullCircle上较最佳既有方法分别提升2.28和1.97分PSNR，网格质量也领先。由此得到兼具实时渲染、全视场光线追踪和碰撞几何的免激光雷达数字孪生。
papers.abstract_en: Robots, autonomous vehicles, and consumer 360° cameras use fisheye lenses for wide fields of view (FoVs). Simulation-ready digital twins require photorealistic rendering across the full FoV and an aligned collision mesh. However, prior fisheye Gaussian Splatting methods only rasterize up to 180° and do not produce meshes, while Gaussian surface reconstruction methods assume pinhole training images. We present GOFish, the first 3D Gaussian Splatting surface reconstruction method to train directly on fisheye images, rasterize FoVs beyond 180°, and extract an aligned mesh from the same scene. Calibrated densification recovers the surface across the entire FoV, while Calibrated Mip Filtering and Wide-Angle Appearance Modeling keep pixel blur and lens falloff out of the scene and mesh. Across the 200° FIORD and 205° FullCircle benchmarks, GOFish improves PSNR over the best prior method by 2.28 and 1.97 dB, respectively. It also outperforms fisheye rendering baselines within their own FoVs and achieves the highest mesh F-score on FIORD and the main ScanNet++ set. Together, the Gaussian scene and mesh form a LiDAR-free, simulation-ready digital twin that renders in real time, ray traces the full FoV, and provides collision geometry.

papers.title_en: Skeleton-Guided Geometry-Aware Auto-Labeling for Robotic Grasping: From 4-DoF Learning to 6-DoF Execution
papers.authors: Ali Sabzejou, Farbod Azimmohseni, Mehdi Tale Masouleh, Ahmad Kalhor
papers.evidence: 机器人抓取方法直接对应物体操作与交互
papers.tldr: 机器人抓取依赖大量人工标注，制作成本高，也难以为复杂三维场景提供一致标签。本文以直骨架自动生成两指抓取关键点和稳定可行区域，并提出骨架引导的 SkelGG-CNN 学习四自由度抓取；广义准三维骨架则直接处理点云，扩展至六自由度标注。四自由度准确率在三个数据集达到95.42%至97.1%，真实机器人在杂乱场景成功率为95%。该方案以几何感知标注降低数据制作负担，为小数据集训练和三维抓取应用提供可扩展途径。
papers.abstract_en: Robotic grasping relies on large manually annotated datasets, which are costly to create. We introduce a straight-skeleton-based algorithm for generating two-finger grasp keypoints and identifying regions suitable for stable, feasible grasps. Our automated pipeline produces consistent grasp annotations without human intervention. We also propose the Skeleton-based Generative Grasp Convolutional Neural Network (SkelGG-CNN), a 4-DoF architecture that learns geometric grasp features from skeleton-based guidance. To extend auto-labeling to 6-DoF grasping, we develop a generalized quasi-3D skeletonization algorithm that operates directly on point clouds. Using automatically generated 4-DoF labels, SkelGG-CNN achieves accuracies of 95.42%, 96.55%, and 97.1% on Jacquard V1, Jacquard V2, and Cornell, respectively. On the GraspNet novel split, 6-DoF auto-labeling achieves an average precision of 18.33, comparable to state-of-the-art model-based approaches. In simulation, the 6-DoF method achieves success rates of 98.4% on Dex-Net and 89.1% on EGAD!. Real-world experiments with a Delta parallel robot show success rates of 97.4% on single household objects and 95.0% in cluttered scenes, outperforming state-of-the-art methods without domain adaptation. The 4-DoF pipeline adapts across environments and produces annotations approaching human-level precision, enabling efficient training of lightweight models on small datasets. The generalized 6-DoF method provides scalable, geometry-aware annotations for cluttered 3D scenes.

papers.title_en: LucidLyra: Feed-Forward Generative 3D Scene Reconstruction and Joint Understanding via Multi-Task Distillation
papers.authors: Oliver Hahn, Rodrigo Marcuzzi, Sangeetha Grama Srinivasan, Alessandro Burzio, Sherwin Bahmani, Jiahui Huang, Stefan Roth, Shengyu Huang, Qunjie Zhou, Laura Leal-Taixé
papers.evidence: 前馈式三维场景重建并联合预测语义与实例
papers.tldr: 生成式三维重建可从单张图像生成虚拟环境，但场景往往缺少可查询的语义与对象身份，限制了机器人和物理智能应用。LucidLyra蒸馏相机控制视频扩散模型及冻结二维视觉基础模型的知识，以前馈方式联合重建三维高斯，并编码几何、外观、开放词汇语义和类别无关实例线索。模型无需人工三维标注、多视图采集或逐场景优化，即可支持新视角渲染、语义分割与对象分组；在合成及真实图像条件基准上超越组合式基线且保持重建质量。该方法还扩展到单目视频动态重建，使生成场景成为可编辑、可检索并可用于机器人仿真的结构化三维世界。
papers.abstract_en: We present LucidLyra, a framework that makes generatively reconstructed 3D scenes directly queryable for semantics and instances in a feed-forward manner from video latents. While generative 3D reconstruction can synthesize virtual environments from a single image, downstream applications in robotics and physical AI require not only visual realism but also access to scene semantics and object identities. Existing 3D understanding approaches, however, require captured multi-view scenes, have limited generalization capabilities, or rely on expensive per-scene processing and optimization. To bridge this gap, our method distills complementary knowledge from a camera-controlled video diffusion model and frozen 2D vision foundation models into a unified model to jointly infer 3D Gaussians encoding geometry, appearance, open-vocabulary semantics, and class-agnostic instance cues. The resulting scenes support novel-view rendering, open-vocabulary segmentation, and object grouping without per-scene optimization, while training requires neither manual 3D annotations nor captured multi-view data. Our method outperforms baselines combining state-of-the-art 3DGS segmentation approaches with generative 3D scene reconstruction on curated synthetic and real-image-conditioned benchmarks, while preserving reconstruction quality. Furthermore, our latent formulation naturally extends to monocular video, reconstructing structured dynamic 3D scenes across time. By turning renderable but unstructured outputs into queryable 3D worlds, LucidLyra enables downstream applications including 3D scene editing, 3D asset mining, and robotic simulation.

papers.title_en: TRACE: Traversability-aware Reactive Navigation via VLM-driven Adaptive Constraints Estimation
papers.authors: Mario A. V. Saucedo, Midhun Edatharam Kunnath, Elias Small, Akash Patel, Shruti Kotpalliwar, Christoforos Kanellakis, George Nikolakopoulos
papers.evidence: 针对地面机器人的可通行性估计与反应式导航
papers.tldr: 非结构化森林地形杂乱、易变形且视觉特征含糊，使地面机器人难以判断哪里可通行并稳定避障。TRACE利用视觉语言模型对正向与负向自然语言提示生成置信图，经证据融合形成突出已有通行迹象的稠密地形地图。系统提取可通行点并拟合路径左右边界，将其作为软障碍约束纳入非线性模型预测控制。真实森林试验显示，该方法能在复杂、易变形及视觉模糊地形中平滑行驶，为复杂自然环境下的自适应反应式导航提供了可行方案。
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents TRACE, a traversability-aware reactive navigation framework designed for the autonomous operation of ground robots in unstructured forest environments. Unlike traditional approaches, TRACE leverages VLM-based confidence maps from positive and negative natural-language prompt sets and combines them through evidential fusion to produce a dense traversability map that prioritizes the terrain based on signs of previously traversed paths. Traversability-annotated points are then extracted and used to derive the left and right boundaries of the traversable path via percentile binning followed by spline or regularized polynomial fitting. These boundaries are then incorporated as soft barrier constraints within an NMPC formulation, enabling safe and adaptive path following in complex natural environments. Rigorous experimental trials carried out in real-life forest environments demonstrate TRACE ability for smooth navigation in cluttered, deformable, and visually ambiguous terrains.

papers.title_en: MAST-VLA: Skill-Conditioned Adaptation with Trajectory-Affordance Priors for Multi-Skill Robot Manipulation
papers.authors: Jiachi Yang, Zhiyi Xu, Hongquan Zhang, Xin Tan, Zhizhong Zhang, Jingyu Gong, Yuan Xie
papers.evidence: 通过视觉语言动作策略学习多技能机器人操作与物体交互。
papers.tldr: 通用机器人操作要求单一视觉语言动作策略在不同场景与指令下完成多种技能，但现有方法对指令中的原语技能选择，以及物体接触位置和运动方式建模不足。MAST-VLA采用双重条件机制：在语言模型骨干中加入技能条件低秩适配器专家混合，并将预测的可供性热图转成动作头使用的补丁级轨迹空间先验。在CALVIN ABC到D跨场景长时序评测中，五子任务序列平均长度达到4.65，并在真实机器人多技能序列实验中验证了部署可行性。结果表明，显式结合技能专门化与轨迹可供性信息，有助于提升多技能泛化及真实操控鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: Generalist robot manipulation requires a single vision-language-action (VLA) policy to execute diverse skills across scenes and instructions. However, current multi-skill VLA policies often leave two aspects of an instruction insufficiently modeled: which primitive skill to execute and where/how to contact and move objects. We propose MAST-VLA (Multi-skill Adaptation with Skill-conditioned experts and Trajectory-affordance priors), a dual-conditioning framework for robot manipulation. MAST-VLA introduces skill-conditioned LoRA Mixture-of-Experts (LoRA-MoE) adapters in the LLM backbone, where skill-query tokens and routing biases guide low-rank expert specialization, and converts a predicted affordance heatmap into a patch-level trajectory-affordance spatial prior for the action head. On the CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D long-horizon multi-skill cross-scene generalization setting, MAST-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance, reaching an Avg. Len of 4.65 over five-subtask evaluation sequences. Real-robot multi-skill sequence experiments further validate its deployability under real perception and control noise.

papers.title_en: What Does World Modeling Actually Improve in Robot Action Learning?
papers.authors: Hanwen Cui, Yuanyuan Li, Qing Guo, Zhida Zhang, Chao Chen, Xi Chen, Jie Cao
papers.evidence: 研究世界模型预测监督对机器人动作学习的影响
papers.tldr: 世界动作模型将未来视频预测与机器人动作学习结合，但成功率提升无法说明预测监督如何改变执行，也不能证明收益能迁移。研究在 FastWAM、OpenWAM 中控制架构、初始化、机器人数据和训练步数，仅消融预测损失，并为 π₀.₅ 加入训练期视频预测目标。干净条件下的已见任务成功率分别提高 24.38 和 72.91 个百分点，轨迹聚类分析显示收益不只来自轨迹模式频率变化。面对未见任务和环境随机化，收益不稳定或不明显；结果支持视频预测作为辅助监督，却不意味着可靠迁移，也表明该设置下无需大型预训练视频扩散模型。
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) combine future-video prediction with robot action learning, yet improvements in task success alone do not reveal how predictive supervision manifests in execution behavior or whether its benefits persist under task and environmental shifts. We conduct controlled future-video prediction loss ablations within FastWAM and OpenWAM, keeping model architecture, initialization, robot training data, and training steps fixed within each model family. Under clean conditions on seen tasks, predictive supervision increases success rates by 24.38 and 72.91 percentage points, respectively. Trajectory clustering further reveals higher success rates within several coarse trajectory clusters, including cases where cluster frequencies change little, indicating that the gains are not solely reflected in changes in the prevalence of trajectory patterns. However, these benefits do not consistently persist under distribution shifts: improvements on unseen tasks vary across models and tasks, while both models exhibit low success rates under the evaluated environmental randomizations, without a consistent advantage from predictive supervision. We further introduce future-video prediction as an auxiliary training objective for $π_{0.5}$, where a lightweight Transformer predictor used only during training increases success from 82.94% to 89.19%. These findings support future-video prediction as effective auxiliary supervision for action learning, while distinguishing improved execution on familiar tasks from reliable transfer and showing that such gains need not rely on a large pretrained video diffusion transformer (DiT) in the evaluated setting.

papers.title_en: Neural Explicit Shape Representation
papers.authors: Jun-Hao Wang, Changan Lu, Baoquan Chen, Peng-Shuai Wang
papers.evidence: 神经表示直接预测射线与连续表面的交点及法线
papers.tldr: 现有神经三维表示通常难以兼顾显式表面查询、直接渲染与跨物体预测，且常需网格提取或逐物体拟合。NeuOctree以稀疏八叉树角点特征构建连续局部场，直接预测射线交点、法线和反照率，并用交点引导采样细化表面查询。七个网格、四种存储预算的28组测试中，其位置误差在24组最低，同时保持有竞争力的法线精度；前馈构建表示仅需0.05秒。该方法统一紧凑逐物体优化与共享模型推理，为直接表面渲染、光线追踪和图像条件生成提供共同表示空间。
papers.abstract_en: Existing neural 3D representations separately address continuous surface modeling, efficient image synthesis, or object-specific compression. They do not jointly provide the explicit surface queries required by ray tracing and a structured output space that can be predicted across objects. We introduce NeuOctree, a neural explicit representation that directly predicts whether and where a ray intersects a surface, together with its normal and albedo. NeuOctree stores shared features at the corners of sparse octree voxels and interpolates them into a continuous local field. A lightweight decoder with recurrent intersection-guided sampling refines each query near the predicted surface, enabling direct surface rendering without mesh extraction or texture baking and accommodating open, non-watertight geometry. The same octree structure supports both compact per-object optimization and a shared octree CNN that constructs renderable assets from colored point clouds without per-object fitting. Across seven meshes and four storage budgets, NeuOctree achieves the lowest positional error in 24 of 28 comparisons while retaining competitive normal accuracy, and substantially improves joint geometry--appearance reconstruction over N-BVH and VQAD. The feedforward model constructs a representation in 0.05 seconds and transfers from Objaverse to ShapeNet without retraining. We further demonstrate ray-traced rendering and image-conditioned generation, showing that NeuOctree provides a common output space for neural inference and direct surface rendering. Code is available at https://github.com/octree-nn/neural-octree.

papers.title_en: OmniQuad: a Wheeled-Legged Hybrid Robot with Omnidirectional Wheels
papers.authors: Francesco Iotti, Alok Ranjan, Franco Angelini, Manolo Garabini
papers.evidence: 轮腿机器人设计用于全向移动和应对地面障碍
papers.tldr: 室内环境需要快速灵活的移动能力，复杂地形与台阶又要求机器人具备足式越障适应性，单一轮式或足式方案难以兼顾。论文提出 OmniQuad，将腿式运动与麦克纳姆轮结合，并设计集成麦克纳姆轮的定制轮足，配合 EM-Act 执行器构成整机。研究还开发了控制方案，并在室内、室外环境开展实验评估。摘要未披露具体指标或对比结果；其主要贡献是展示一种兼具全向机动潜力与腿式运动能力的混合机器人设计。
papers.abstract_en: Combining wheeled and legged locomotion within a single robotic platform offers the potential to harness the advantages of both systems. The development of such hybrid systems remains an active area of research. While legged robots exhibit remarkable adaptability for traversing uneven and rugged terrains, their relatively low speed limits their practicality in indoor environments. Conversely, wheeled robots demonstrate higher efficiency on flat surfaces but often encounter difficulties when navigating obstacles such as steps. This paper introduces OmniQuad, a novel hybrid robot that integrates mecanum wheels with legged locomotion to exploit the benefits of both modalities. Mecanum wheels provide omnidirectional mobility, enhancing the robot's manoeuvrability by enabling agile movement in confined spaces and the ability to maintain a consistent orientation during task execution. In this work, we first present the design of a custom wheeled-foot featuring mecanum wheels. Subsequently, we describe the complete robot assembly, comprising these wheeled feet and EM-Act actuators. Finally, we detail the control scheme developed to govern the OmniQuad and evaluate its performance through experimental trials conducted in both indoor and outdoor environments.

papers.title_en: EmbodiExp: Compositional Experience Transfer for Embodied Agents
papers.authors: Zhifeng Gu, Ying Chen, Rui Jiang, Lei Yi, Bing Wang
papers.evidence: 研究具身智能体如何组合经验并将高层计划转化为落地动作。
papers.tldr: 具身智能体可借助经验把高层计划转化为落地动作，但经验跨任务迁移困难：旧策略未必适配当前状态，也可能无法产生预期结果。EmbodiExp围绕可独立判定完成情况的共享子目标，构建包含子目标、适用条件、可调整策略与可验证结果的经验；执行时匹配适用经验，并用已验证结果满足后续经验的条件，实现在线组合。框架还按子目标归因结果，让失败轨迹中的局部成功和避错指引得以保留。在多个具身基准、折叠式评测及冻结经验库设置下，实验验证其有效性，为经验的可组合迁移与失败利用提供了方法。
papers.abstract_en: Experience can help embodied agents turn high-level plans into grounded actions, but transferring it across tasks remains challenging: previously effective strategies may be inapplicable to the current state or fail to produce their intended outcomes. We present EmbodiExp, a framework for constructing transferable experiences and composing them online during embodied task execution. Our key observation is that tasks often share subgoals whose completion can be assessed independently of overall task success. We therefore introduce an outcome-grounded subgoal experience that specifies a subgoal, applicability conditions, an adaptable policy, and a verifiable outcome. During execution, applicable experiences guide action generation, while verified outcomes can establish the conditions required by subsequent experiences, enabling online composition. Subgoal-level outcome attribution further enables failure utilization: failed trajectories can still contribute verified local successes and condition-specific guidance on actions to avoid. Experiments on multiple embodied benchmarks under a fold-based protocol with frozen experience banks demonstrate the effectiveness of EmbodiExp.

papers.title_en: Continuous-Action World Models: Learning Cross-Embodiment Spatiotemporal Dynamics Priors
papers.authors: Liangyu Li, Qingwen Liu
papers.evidence: 学习预测环境动态并支持跨机器人身体的动作生成
papers.tldr: 机器人跨本体迁移常受动作表示与控制频率不一致制约，异构轨迹难以共同利用。CoAWM先将不同机器人、不同采样频率的轨迹映射到共享潜在函数空间，通过动作重建及跨时间采样视图一致性学习动力学先验。随后将该空间接入世界模型，由观测、语言指令和机器人状态条件化动作函数，再由单一解码器按任意查询时刻输出末端动作。该框架分离共享动力学先验、任务条件动作选择与时间采样，旨在支持跨本体、跨控制频率迁移；摘要未报告量化实验结果。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Continuous-Action World Models (CoAWM), a framework for learning cross-embodiment spatiotemporal dynamics priors that support robot action generation across embodiments and execution frequencies. At its core is a shared latent function space that captures the spatial and temporal structure of robot actions. We learn this space through two stages. First, function pretraining brings trajectories from different embodiments and sampling frequencies into a common representation, learning shared dynamics priors through action reconstruction and consistency across temporal sampling views. By accommodating heterogeneous robot trajectories, this stage broadens the range of data sources available for pretraining and facilitates scaling to larger and more diverse datasets. Second, we connect the pretrained function space to a world-model backbone, enabling observations, language instructions, and the current robot state to condition the prediction of a latent action function. A single decoder takes any query time and returns the corresponding end-effector action. By separating shared dynamics priors from task-conditioned action selection and temporal sampling, our approach provides a unified foundation for transferring robot experience across embodiments and control frequencies.

papers.title_en: PrefO2O: Zero-Shot Preference-Based Reinforcement Learning via Offline-to-Online Latent Preference Transfer
papers.authors: Ruiqi Wang, Dezhong Zhao, Xuesu Xiao, Erdem Biyik, Byung-Cheol Min, Guohua Chen
papers.evidence: 机器人行为的偏好学习与迁移
papers.tldr: 偏好强化学习能让机器人行为贴合人类意图，但每个新任务都重新采集偏好标签，成本高且难以扩展。PrefO2O仅用少量源任务离线偏好数据，学习任务不变的潜在偏好空间，分离可迁移结构与任务差异，并通过置信度加权最优传输为目标任务生成伪偏好，在线适配奖励。实验覆盖机器人操作与运动控制，在多对一、一对一及不同机器人本体迁移中优于既有偏好迁移方法，并可匹配或超过使用真实反馈训练的方法。该框架无需目标任务人类反馈，实现分布变化下的零样本偏好迁移，为降低偏好强化学习跨任务应用成本提供途径。
papers.abstract_en: Preference-based reinforcement learning (PbRL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for learning robot behaviors aligned with human intent. However, its scalability is fundamentally limited by the need to collect expensive human preference labels for every new task. In this work, we present PrefO2O, an offline-to-online latent preference transfer framework that enables zero-shot PbRL on unseen target tasks without requiring any human feedback. The core idea is to learn a task-invariant latent preference space from a small amount of offline preference data on source tasks, where transferable preference structures are disentangled from task-specific variations. This learned manifold allows PrefO2O to transfer preference structures and reward priors to new tasks under distribution shift, while confidence-weighted optimal transport alignment generates reliable pseudo-preference supervision for online reward adaptation. Extensive experiments on robotic manipulation and locomotion benchmarks demonstrate that PrefO2O substantially outperforms existing preference-transfer baselines and matches or exceeds PbRL methods trained with real human feedback, while generalizing across multi-to-one and one-to-one transfer settings as well as across different robot embodiments.

papers.title_en: Joint Rigid Alignment and Morphable Reconstruction from Partial 3D Face Scans
papers.authors: Eli A. Underwood, Nicolas Rondan, Angel V. Peterchev, J. Matias Di Martino
papers.evidence: 从部分三维面部扫描联合预测刚性姿态和完整形状
papers.tldr: 真实三维人脸扫描往往只覆盖部分区域，既需要估计扫描姿态，也要补全未观测的脸部形状；传统流程分步处理这两项任务，可能造成误差累积。本文将刚性对齐与形状重建整合到单一网络中，利用GeoTransformer特征、粗对应关系及离线学习的3D形变模型预测完整人脸，并同步完成精细匹配和位姿估计。留出身份测试中，其顶点误差较最强基线低约3至4倍；在NoW与NPHM真实扫描上也同时取得最高精度和速度。该方法无需人工标注形变系数，为不完整人脸扫描提供了统一、高效的重建方案。
papers.abstract_en: Aligning a partial, real-world 3D face scan to a canonical representation requires solving two coupled problems at once: estimating the rigid pose that brings the scan into a common frame, and completing the facial shape in regions the scan never observed. Existing pipelines typically decouple these steps, running a generic point-cloud registration front end followed by a separate non-rigid fitting or deformation stage. Building on the GeoTransformer superpoint-matching architecture, we propose a single network that predicts both a rigid pose and a shape-complete point cloud in one forward pass: a cross-attention regressor, conditioned on transformer point features and predicted coarse correspondences, maps a partial scan to per-patch coefficients of a 3D morphable face model learned offline from a corpus of 8,000 identities. The resulting morphed template is then used, in the same forward pass, as the target for fine-grained Sinkhorn matching and rigid pose estimation, supervised purely by geometric alignment to ground-truth morphed geometry, so no hand-labeled coefficients are required. Against six classical and learned non-rigid registration baselines on held-out identities, our method leads the strongest ones by 3-4 times on per-vertex error and baselines that collapse the head onto the visible region by more than an order of magnitude, and is simultaneously the most accurate and fastest method on ground-truth-free scans from two independent real-scan datasets, NoW and NPHM. Code will be made publicly available.

papers.title_en: ACD-GS: Asymmetric Curvature-aware Densification for 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Houqiang Zhong, Tianchi Zhu, Qiang Hu, Xiaoyun Zhang, Li Song, Wenjun Zhang
papers.evidence: 改进三维高斯场景表示的增密策略与几何重建
papers.tldr: 3D高斯泼溅能实现实时新视角合成，但依赖一阶屏幕空间梯度的启发式增密容易把纹理高频和噪声误判为几何细节，造成高斯冗余与几何重建不准。ACD-GS以二阶深度响应作为结构先验，非对称调节克隆和分裂，并结合多视图光度一致性抑制单视角误差。训练中还通过容量感知策略协调增密与剪枝，直接减少冗余生成。实验表明，高斯数量和存储量减少近60%，渲染保真度仍具竞争力，且在多个数据集上优于现有方法。
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for real-time photorealistic novel view synthesis. However, its training-time densification remains largely heuristic, often resulting in redundant Gaussian proliferation and inaccurate geometric reconstruction. Existing methods predominantly rely on first-order screen-space gradients to trigger cloning and splitting, which fail to distinguish true geometric discontinuities from high-frequency textures or noisy residuals. To address this limitation, we propose ACD-GS, an Asymmetric Curvature-aware Densification framework for compact and geometry-aware 3D Gaussian optimization. Our key insight is that second-order depth responses provide a more reliable structural prior for density control, enabling asymmetric regulation of cloning and splitting to better capture geometric discontinuities. Building on this, we introduce a multi-view photometric consistency constraint to suppress transient single-view errors, together with a capacity-aware adaptive regulation strategy that balances densification and pruning during training. Unlike post-hoc compression or quantization-based approaches, ACD-GS directly prevents redundant Gaussian generation during training, yielding inherently compact representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method reduces nearly 60% of Gaussian count and storage while maintaining competitive rendering fidelity, consistently outperforming existing methods across multiple datasets. Our code is available in https://waveviewer.github.io/ACD-GS/.

papers.title_en: UT-HMR: Uncertainty-Guided Temporal Modeling for Robust 3D Human Mesh Recovery
papers.authors: Zhibo Wang, Sirisha Rambhatla, Yuhao Chen, Maria Koshkina, David Clausi
papers.evidence: 单目三维人体网格恢复与三维几何估计相关
papers.tldr: 单目三维人体网格恢复在远距离、遮挡和运动模糊下容易出现姿态歧义，单阶段方法缺少裁剪图像及外部二维线索，尤为困难。UT-HMR为每个人体查询建模完整SMPL姿态的相关不确定性，并用低秩加对角协方差生成关节精度权重；时序早期融合则在姿态解码前引入邻帧视觉证据。轻量级ViT-B在冰球和足球基准上达到最优，误差指标最高降低4.7%至5.6%，在3DPW上也具竞争力。该方法以不确定性刻画歧义、以时间信息消解歧义，增强了弱观测场景下的鲁棒恢复。
papers.abstract_en: Monocular 3D human mesh recovery (HMR) remains unreliable under weak observations caused by long camera-to-person distances, occlusion, and motion blur. In challenging scenarios such as sports, these factors make the problem highly ambiguous, as different 3D poses may yield similar 2D projections. This ambiguity is especially severe for one-stage HMR, which recovers all meshes directly from the full image without person crops or external 2D cues. To handle this ambiguity, we present UT-HMR ( Uncertainty-guided Temporal HMR), to our knowledge the first one-stage HMR framework to capture correlated pose uncertainty across joints. Each person query predicts a Gaussian distribution over the full SMPL pose with a compact low-rank-plus-diagonal covariance, which is converted into joint-wise precision weights for heteroscedastic supervision while keeping inference deterministic. Temporal early fusion further injects neighboring-frame evidence before pose decoding, supplying the visual evidence needed to resolve the ambiguity that the uncertainty captures. With a lightweight ViT-B backbone, UT-HMR achieves state-of-the-art results on VIP-HockeyPose-v2 (ice hockey) and WorldPose (soccer), reducing MPJPE, PA-MPJPE, and PVE by up to 4.7%, 3.8%, and 5.6%, and remains competitive on 3DPW against methods with larger backbones and higher input resolutions.

papers.title_en: Self-Consistency Geometry Injection for Multi-view Consistent Image Generation
papers.authors: Yupeng Xiao, Yankai Wu, Jianjie Luo, Jiajie Lin, Yi Yu, Zhenguo Yang
papers.evidence: 通过可靠性感知几何注入提升多视图生成的几何一致性
papers.tldr: 单图生成多视角图像时，几何与纹理耦合或将预测几何视为固定条件，容易让错误几何线索损害视图一致性。为此，论文提出可靠性引导的多视角生成方法 RGMV，以多种随机配置为同一参考图像和目标视角生成几何预测，并通过空间一致性估计可靠性图。可靠性感知几何注入模块据此调节几何条件残差：稳定区域保留较强几何引导，不可靠区域降低注入强度。实验显示，该方法提升了多视角生成的几何质量，并能适配不同几何提议生成器，为减少不可靠几何传播提供了有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: Recent diffusion models have achieved impressive progress in single image to multi-view generation by synthesizing consistent novel views efficiently. Existing methods usually explicitly or implicitly couple geometry inference and texture synthesis, making generation vulnerable to inaccurate geometry prediction. Although several geometry-guided methods have explored decoupling, they usually treat predicted geometry as a fixed condition and do not explicitly model whether the geometry is reliable. We therefore propose Reliability-Guided Multi-View Generation (RGMV), which comprises a parameter-free Self-Consistency Geometry Gate (SCG) and a Reliability-aware Geometry Injection (RGI) module. Specifically, a geometry proposal generator produces multiple geometry predictions for the same reference image and target viewpoints under different stochastic sampling configurations. SCG measures their spatial agreement to derive a reliability map, which RGI uses to modulate the injection strength of geometry-conditioned residuals in the RGB synthesis model. Moreover, RGMV can adapt to different geometry proposal generators. As a result, RGMV preserves stronger geometric guidance in stable regions while attenuating unreliable geometry cues before they propagate into multi-view RGB generation. Extensive experiments show that reliability-aware geometry injection improves the geometric quality of multi-view generation. Code: https://github.com/WISLab-GDUT/RGMV.

papers.title_en: OneScene-Bench: Do Vision-Language Models Integrate Evidence Across Views?
papers.authors: Swathi Suhas, Anurag Das, Bernt Schiele, Jonas Fischer
papers.evidence: 基准测试真实多视图场景中的跨视角一致性、空间推理与对象计数。
papers.tldr: 视觉语言模型虽能接收同一场景的多张图像，但答对任务未必意味着它们建立了跨视角对应或场景级表征。本文提出 OneScene-Bench，以真实多视角场景和受控设计，检验唯一物体计数、跨视角一致性与空间推理，并区分逐图处理可解和必须匹配实例的情形。对十二种开源及专有模型的评测显示，互补视图计数准确率仅为4.5%–50.0%，低于完整重叠样例的45.5%–81.5%；一致性判断约为50%，空间推理相对更强。结果揭示多图处理与证据整合之间的显著落差，并为评估场景级多视角理解提供更有针对性的基准。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly process multiple views of the same scene, but it remains unclear whether they integrate these observations into a coherent scene-level representation. Existing multi-image evaluations do not isolate this capability, as tasks may admit correct solutions through independent per-view processing without requiring cross-view correspondence. We introduce OneScene-Bench, a controlled benchmark designed to explicitly distinguish when cross-view integration is necessary. Our benchmark evaluates three complementary capabilities on real-world multi-view scenes: unique object counting, cross-view consistency, and spatial reasoning. For counting, we control object overlap across views to separate cases solvable by simple per-view aggregation from those requiring instance-level correspondence. For consistency, we introduce localized edits in shared and view-specific regions, testing whether models distinguish genuine scene contradictions from differences caused by viewpoint and visibility. For spatial reasoning, we construct object relations that require combining spatial evidence across viewpoints to compare physical proximity. We evaluate twelve state-of-the-art open-weight and proprietary VLMs and find that counting accuracy drops substantially on complementary views, ranging from 4.5-50.0%, compared with 45.5-81.5% on complete-overlap examples. Moreover, cross-view consistency remains around 50% across models, including recent proprietary VLMs, despite substantially stronger performance on spatial reasoning. Our results reveal a substantial gap between processing multiple images and integrating evidence across them, highlighting the need for evaluations that explicitly test scene-level multi-view understanding. Code and data are available at https://github.com/swathisuhas/OneScene-Bench.

papers.title_en: Robust LIDAR Sensor-to-Sensor Domain Generalization via Accumulated-Point Scene Completion
papers.authors: Christoph B Rist, Larissa T Triess, Markus Enzweiler, Dariu M Gavrila
papers.evidence: 针对点云场景分割的跨传感器泛化
papers.tldr: 激光雷达语义分割模型常受传感器采样模式差异影响，在训练未见的新传感器上容易失效，而实际部署往往无法获得目标域数据或标签。本文提出仅用源域训练的方案，将多帧扫描聚合成简易世界模型，并以占用预测补充语义分割监督。网络输入仍为单帧点云，推理时可移除辅助头，不增加计算开销。跨数据集实验显示，该监督方式在部分设置中提升未见域表现，同时保持有竞争力的源域精度，为无需适配的跨传感器泛化提供简单路径。
papers.abstract_en: We study domain generalization for LIDAR semantic segmentation. Deep neural networks achieve strong performance on 3D point clouds, yet real-world LIDAR exhibits sensor-specific sampling patterns that hinder transfer across datasets. In many applications, performance on completely unseen sensors is crucial. A model should preferably work on a new setup without prior access to its data or labels. To this end, we introduce a source-only training scheme that adds an occupancy prediction auxiliary objective. We aggregate source-domain scans into a simple world model and use it as the supervision signal, replacing single-scan standard segmentation training.   A key property of our approach is that it does not alter the input scan. During training and testing the network consumes the same single-frame LIDAR input, only the supervision signal is enriched via the occupancy objective. At deployment, there is no runtime overhead as the auxiliary head can be dropped for pure segmentation, or kept to obtain scene completion alongside semantic segmentation. In an experimental evaluation across distinct LIDAR datasets, we demonstrate that a model's generalization to new domains can be significantly affected by how it is supervised. In certain setups, performance on unseen domains improves without any explicit domain adaptation (no target scans, no target labels, no sensor priors) and without prediction refinement. At the same time, our method maintains competitive source-domain segmentation performance and incurs no additional inference cost.

papers.title_en: PhysInsert: Physically Plausible Object Insertion with Geometric Priors and Bidirectional Object-Scene Interactions
papers.authors: Yue Gong, Le Zhang, Rui Chen, Song Chang, Xiaochao Qu, Luoqi Liu, Ting Liu, Yebin Liu
papers.evidence: 利用VGGT几何流指导对象与目标场景的空间适配
papers.tldr: 参考图像物体插入需要适应目标场景的视角、姿态与光照，但现有方法常缺乏充分约束，也难以同步处理物体和环境变化。PhysInsert构建跨视角、跨光照且严格对齐的Blender反事实数据集，并结合VGGT几何引导适配与二维物体—场景空间监督，使插入位置和场景响应得到联合建模。在PhysInsert-Bench和DreamBooth上，方法提升了图像保真度；用户研究也显示，放置、光照融合、透视和姿态更合理。该工作以几何先验和双向交互监督，推动参考物体插入向更具物理可信度发展。
papers.abstract_en: We present PhysInsert, a framework for physically plausible reference-based object insertion that jointly adapts objects and their surrounding scenes. Existing methods often rely on masked inputs, generation-based pairs, or training pairs with limited viewpoint variation, leaving pose and illumination adaptation and bidirectional object-scene interactions insufficiently constrained. We construct the Insert World dataset with strictly aligned Blender-rendered counterfactual pairs and object references across viewpoints and lighting conditions. Building on these data, Geometry-Guided Adaptation couples a VGGT geometry stream with image and text streams under target-scene feature supervision to guide spatially consistent insertion. Complementary 2D Object-Scene Spatial Supervision jointly supervises object occupancy and environmental changes while grounding spatial instructions in object regions through image-text attention. We introduce PhysInsert-Bench with dedicated cross-environment and cross-view cases requiring illumination and pose adaptation beyond appearance copying. Experiments on PhysInsert-Bench and DreamBooth demonstrate improved image fidelity; a user study further shows more accurate placement and improved lighting integration, perspective, and pose plausibility.

papers.title_en: CrossWeave: Cross-Modal Scene and Instance Retrieval from Sparse 2D-3D Alignment
papers.authors: Aadith Warrier, Gnana Prakash Punnavajhala, Siddharth Tourani, Muhammad Haris Khan, Avinash Sharma, Madhava Krishna
papers.evidence: 以二维图像查询三维场景，并学习局部图像块与三维点之间的对应关系。
papers.tldr: 跨模态检索希望根据二维图像找到对应的三维场景或物体，是机器人与增强现实、虚拟现实空间理解的基础。既有方法多在完整场景或物体层面对齐，难以监督内部局部结构，且往往为两类检索分别训练模型。CrossWeave改为学习稀疏的图像块—三维点对应，无需场景级或实例级对比目标；再以最优传输聚合对齐特征，合并结构冗余区域，为语义不同的局部特征释放描述能力。在ScanNet和3RScan上，单一模型均取得场景与实例检索最佳表现，说明稀疏局部对应足以支撑统一检索，也表明完整场景编码并非必要。
papers.abstract_en: Cross-modal scene and instance retrieval aims to retrieve a corresponding 3D environment or object given query 2D images, serving as a foundational mechanism for spatial reasoning in robotics and AR/VR. Existing methods achieve this by learning alignment only at the level of whole scenes or objects, which provides no supervision for the fine-grained local structure within them. In this work, we show that supervision on a set of sparse 2D-3D correspondences, without scene- or instance-level contrastive objectives, is sufficient to train a single model for both scene- and instance-level retrieval. Specifically, we propose $\textbf{CrossWeave}$, a novel framework for cross-modal retrieval that learns sparse patch-point alignment, which alone outperforms existing methods. An optimal transport-based aggregator over the aligned features gives further gains by clustering structurally redundant regions, freeing descriptor capacity for semantically distinct local features. CrossWeave achieves state-of-the-art performance on both scene- and instance-level retrieval on ScanNet and 3RScan with a $\textit{single model}$, whereas existing methods require separate models for each task. Our results suggest that whole-scene encoding is unnecessary for cross-modal retrieval and that sparse local correspondence supervision is a more effective and flexible alternative.
